title: Funding Credit on Universal Life Insurance Full-Surrender Charges
content:
**What is the funding credit?** On a full surrender of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy, the funding credit reduces the surrender charge according to how well the policy has been funded. It follows the gross premiums received in the policy's activity history against the target premium times the policy year of the surrender.

**What figures are compared?** The gross premiums received are the total of the gross amounts of every premium received entry in the activity history. The funding figure is the policy's target premium, from the policy record, times the policy year in which the surrender is effective.

**What credit is earned?**

| Gross premiums received compared with the funding figure | Funding credit |
|---|---|
| At least **1.5** times the funding figure (the high funding multiple) | High funding credit, **10%** (0.10) |
| At least the funding figure, below 1.5 times it | Standard funding credit, **5%** (0.05) |
| Below the funding figure | No credit |

**How does the credit act?** The charge is multiplied by one less the credit: by 0.90 with the high credit and by 0.95 with the standard credit, before the charge is rounded to the cent.

**Worked cases (hypothetical; target premium $4000.00, surrender in policy year 6, funding figure $24000.00, high threshold $36000.00).**

| Gross premiums received | Credit |
|---|---|
| $36000.00 | 10% |
| $35999.99 | 5% |
| $24000.00 | 5% |
| $23999.99 | None |

A charge of $5000.0000 before the credit becomes $4500.0000 with the high credit and $4750.0000 with the standard credit.
